latestNote: ★ Feb 10, 2026 update: Drop rate maintained at 23% -- highest in 11 harvests. Rainfall 10% below historical average. Fruit weight 1g below projection. Final estimate due April 10, 2026.
greeningNote: 26.5% of infected trees show symptoms in >75% of canopy. Greening + drought together reduce productive potential by approximately 35%. Most affected areas: Limeira, Porto Ferreira, Avaré (>60% incidence).
brazilSummary: Brazil 2025/26: forecast cut 4 times. Greening affects 47.6% of trees. Drop rate 23% -- worst in 11 years.
floridaSummary: Florida: January cold may have caused tree damage. Frozen fruit going to processors. Harvest wrapping up.
demandSummary: Demand remains weak -- consumers adjusted to high prices. Market expects demand suppression to continue near-term.
